verdict.rationale: Figma Make is a SaaS AI app/prototype builder, so offering registrable outbound webhooks is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no webhook subscription capability. MCP connections to external tools, adding a backend, and web fetching are adjacent features and do not count as outbound HTTP event callbacks. Community notes that Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, so there is no evidence of programmatic event delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
